name: Walker
author: brodgar
description: Write-actions demo — a small, DORMANT, opt-in addon that DECLARES the 'actions' permission (the gated write tier: hafen.act.* plus the per-subsystem write verbs, the only parts of hafen.* that DRIVE the character). Write-actions are a PER-ADDON permission (D-027/D-028): there is NO global switch — it is therefore DISABLED BY DEFAULT when first discovered (opt-in per addon). To use it, enable it in Options > AddOns and CONFIRM the consent dialog (it can act on your behalf), then Reload UI: it logs at login that write-actions are GRANTED. Each action verb is a DELIBERATE ':walker <sub>' trigger (nothing acts unless you ask): walk=moveTo, click=clickGob(right-click), use=useItemOn, sel=select, place=place, raw=the raw escape hatch, menu=hafen.act.menu(path), flower=hafen.act.flower(label), item=hafen.act.item(item, verb), and the 4g per-subsystem verbs speed=hafen.speed.set(n), craft=hafen.craft.make(all), bar=hafen.actionbar(n):use(), setbar=hafen.actionbar(n):set(resourceName) (assign an action to a slot by resource name — what dragging it off the menu grid does; the write is asynchronous, so the slot changes a beat later, as an ActionbarChanged), kin=hafen.kin():add(secret) plus the Kin object's chainable :rename/:setGroup/:endkin/:forget(name,...). Leave it disabled (the default) and it never acts. Kept SEPARATE from the read-only 'hello' regression harness (which declares no permissions).
